html:
SMTO-TSK-0035 — That task filter isn't recognized

GUID: aeec19a2-be66-4733-8ae0-98f58318329b
Slug: task-status-invalid
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to show or clear tasks with a status it doesn't know, so it did nothing. No tasks were changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page so the task list uses SMTO's current filter choices. An old tab or bookmark can send a status name SMTO no longer uses.
  2. Choose the filter or clear option again from the choices on the page. The choices on the page always match what SMTO accepts.
  3. If a script or bookmarked link made this request, change it to use a status such as running, completed, failed or cancelled. SMTO refuses status names it doesn't recognize.

What success looks like

  • The list shows the tasks you expected, or the clear action finishes.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't repeat the same link or script call unchanged; it will be refused the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A task or run list/delete request supplied a status filter outside the route's supported set, so it was rejected before any listing or deletion.

What this means

  • Task/run listing or deletion receives a normalized status outside that route's supported status set. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • Task/run listing or deletion receives a normalized status outside that route's supported status set.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the requested filter with the current route's status contract; this is not evidence that a stored task has changed state.

How to fix it

  • Use a supported status: run list/delete accepts all, open, pending, running, awaiting_confirmation, awaiting_clarification, interrupted, completed, failed or cancelled; task list and task clear accept queued, running, awaiting_confirmation, awaiting_clarification, interrupted, completed, failed, cancelled or archived. Reload stale clients that send an outdated value.
  • Use a status advertised by the current task/run controls and refresh stale client state.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported status filter returns the intended reviewable selection.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
